notice.title: Please read before uploading
notice.body: Verification documents are used only to confirm your review and award bonus points. Please mask sensitive information such as salary, A-number, SEVIS ID, receipt numbers, date of birth, and address before uploading. Files are permanently deleted within 72 hours after review, and no later than 7 days after upload. Only the verification result (verified status and company or visa type) is kept. Please do not send documents by email or message.
notice.agree: I have read the above and agree to how my verification documents are handled. (Required)
notice.screenshotTip: We recommend an email screenshot. It has far less to mask than a photo of a card or paper document.
notice.maskTip: You'll mask every image yourself in the next step, and only the masked version is sent. Photo data such as location is also removed on our server.
